comparison.objective: Set a snap trap without allowing its hammer to strike a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-loaded hammer back while placing a lock bar into its catch, then withdraw safely.
comparison.success_condition: Trap latched with hammer ≥160° back and arms returned; snap or unprotected strike-path entry permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Tests bimanual restraint and latching of stored spring energy rather than calibrated adjustment and repeated impact performance.
